stem: The common difference of the A.P. a₁, a₂, ……, aₘ is 13 more than the common difference of the A.P. b₁, b₂, ……, bₙ. If b₂₁ = −277, b₃₃ = −385 and a₇₈ = 327, then a₁ is equal to (a) 21 (b) 16 (c) 24 (d) 19 [JEE Main 2026 28 Jan Shift 1]
If the sum of the first four terms of an A.P. is 6 and the sum of its first six terms is 4, then the sum of its first twelve is (a) −20 (b) −22 (c) −26 (d) −24 [JEE Main 2026, 22 Jan Shift 1]

Consider an A.P. of positive integers, whose sum of the first three terms is 54 and the sum of the first twenty terms lies between 1600 and 1800. Then its 11 th term is (a) 90 (b) 84 (c) 122 (d) 108 [JEE Main 2025, 29 Jan Shift 1]

Suppose a₁, a₂, ……, a n , …… be an arithmetic progression of natural numbers. If the ratio of the sum of the first five terms to the sum of first nine terms of the progression is 5 : 17 and 110 < a₁₅ < 120, then the sum of the first ten terms of the progression is equal to (a) 290 (b) 380 (c) 460 (d) 510 [JEE Main 2022, 27 Jul Shift 1]
